previous_description: A derived or virtual collection that presents data from one or more source collections. Paradigm-neutral: covers SQL views and materialized views, search engine aliases, document store views (CouchDB), time-series continuous aggregates (TimescaleDB), and named graph projections.
definition: A named collection registered in the data store engine whose contents are derived, by a stored query, pipeline or alias, from one or more source collections or views rather than written directly by applications. It is read like a collection and may be computed on each read or precomputed and refreshed.

distinguish_from.when: the container holds base records that applications insert directly, including a table filled by an ETL job or by a $merge/$out stage, since the engine does not maintain it from a defining query

the query or pipeline is invoked procedurally (called with parameters, run as a scheduled task or script) rather than exposed as a named, queryable object, e.g. an InfluxDB continuous query writing into a measurement
the query lives only in application or repository code and is not registered in the engine as a named derived object
the element is the lifecycle rule that downsamples or expires data, not the derived aggregate that results from it

standard_reference: ISO/IEC 9075-2 (SQL/Foundation) <view definition> (CREATE VIEW); materialized views and non-relational aliases or aggregates are paradigm extensions
code_evidence: a CREATE VIEW, CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW or CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW statement in a migration or schema file, often paired with a REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW job

a MongoDB db.createView(name, source, pipeline) call, an Elasticsearch _aliases or index-template alias definition, or a TimescaleDB CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... WITH (timescaledb.continuous) statement

an ORM entity mapped to a read-only database object, such as a Django model with managed=False whose db_table names a view, a Hibernate @Immutable/@Subselect entity, or an SQLAlchemy Table reflected from a view
notes: 'materialized' is redundant with viewType and can contradict it (e.g. ALIAS with materialized=true); consider deriving it. InfluxDB continuous queries appear both here (CONTINUOUS_AGGREGATE) and under storedlogic CONTINUOUS_QUERY. FILTERED overlaps VIRTUAL. An 'updatable' attribute is missing. The derives-from relationships carry the source collections, so no sourceCollections attribute is needed.
